profile.solver_method: Pure-stdlib acceptance fixtures for Minimum-MR-SubSet toy and P1 heat slices
profile.input_contract: JSON cases with kind=toy_sort or kind=p1_heat.
profile.output_contract: JSON scalar metrics used by imported acceptance MRs.
profile.adapter: Pure-stdlib Python runner and JSON parser under SUT/external_acceptance_minmr/.

mrs.description: Sorting output checksum is invariant under input permutation.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Permutation invariance for a deterministic sorting toy program.
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply PermuteIndices to /values while preserving the multiset.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe sorted_checksum from source and follow-up outputs.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: ApproxEqual checks exact checksum preservation with a tight deterministic tolerance.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: Absolute tolerance 1e-12 covers only floating serialization noise.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable to the local acceptance toy_sort JSON sample.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure means the adapter or sorting fixture no longer preserves permutation invariance.

mrs.display_name: Minimum-MR P1 heat - alpha monotonic smoothing
mrs.description: Increasing heat diffusivity alpha at fixed final time decreases the maximum temperature.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Diffusion smooths faster when alpha increases.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: LessThan checks follow-up max_u < source max_u.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable to stable explicit heat samples.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates the P1 heat acceptance slice violated alpha smoothing monotonicity.

mrs.description: Doubling the time-step count should keep max_u within the convergence tolerance.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: A stable explicit heat solver should approach a plateau as time steps are refined.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable to the local p1_heat sample.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates the acceptance heat slice did not preserve timestep convergence.

mrs.description: Doubling grid points should keep max_u within the mesh-convergence tolerance.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: A smooth heat solution should remain close when the grid is refined.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable to the local p1_heat sample.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates the acceptance heat slice did not preserve mesh convergence.
